title: Sales router (F-008 API)
scope: APIRouter(prefix='/sales', tags=['sales']). POST /sales → 201. GET /sales with optional date_from, date_to, dealer_ids (List[int]), design_ids (List[int]) query params. Filters will be reused by S3 Sales Report.

success_criteria.manual: POST a sale; GET filters by dealer/design.
success_criteria.definition_of_done: 2 endpoints; multi-select query params accept `dealer_ids=1&dealer_ids=2` style.

checkout_prompt: 'Sales router — POST + GET on /api/v1/sales with multi-select filters.'
